## Objective

If activated, integrate trajectories only at unique patch points and differentiate the actual discrete integrator. Include Dv(z) eta + v_h(z), consistent adjoints, stage caching, inverse and digital-topology checks.

## Source and ownership

PRD: `docs/plans/flashalign-implementation-prd.md` (version 2, SHA-256 `a66500fec106a0df0f6635bb81329f44cca0a031cab32958c6c370f2ca6fc929`). Relevant sections/work packages: 10.1, FA-13. Original proposal and Python oracles are in `docs/plans/flashalign/` and `docs/plans/flashalign-prd.md`.

Planned paths (reserve exact paths at implementation time):
- `qualified flow/provider changes`
- `sparse trajectory and adjoint suites`

## Acceptance criteria

1. Finite differences/adjoint checks establish the discrete exponential derivative, with no displacement-derivative shortcut.
2. Step size, sampled/digital folds, regridding, inverse domain/residual, memory and full costs are independently qualified.
3. No dense velocity-to-image Jacobian or continuum-only SmoothIso claim; remain blocked until positive F03 activation.

## Blocking prerequisites

- F03 (`bd-01M2B11BB6FWN35SGHWCCRJVVY`): FA-F03: Decide whether a Flashalign velocity model adds value beyond HalfFlow

## Evidence and completion

Record exact candidate/provider hashes, relevant commands and outcomes, fixture/config identities, numerical tolerances and all failure cases. Run the task-specific independent checks above and affected JVM/Scala.js/consumer gates; keep timing and scientific accuracy claims separate. Missing required input or a failing admission gate remains blocked, not silently passed. A completed experiment may report no benefit; dependent release/adoption milestones must still assess their own criteria.

## Integration constraints

Use canonical image4s/Ravel/Gale and existing reframe4s map/resample/registration ownership, typed failures and immutable plans with explicit workspaces. Preserve strict compiler policy, current motion/HalfFlow defaults, dirty-tree ownership and frozen experiments. Keep Flashalign linear execution free of nonlinear setup and direct HalfFlow dependencies. Shared primitives migrate through their current owner with both-consumer evidence; do not merge method objectives.

## Conditional activation

Initially BLOCKED, priority 3, excluded from required epic completion. Prerequisite completion alone is insufficient: record a positive evidence-backed activation decision before moving this task to open/doing. A defer/reject decision leaves implementation blocked or explicitly retires it without success claims.
